tei:div.tei:p: "!#༄༅// bla chen yab sras dril sgrub kyi las byang chog khrigs byin rlabs sprin phung zhes bya ba bzhugs so//

byin rlabs dngos grub phrin las kyi// rtsa ba gsum la nyer btud nas// 'chi med rig 'dzin bcud dril gyi// las byang go bder 'god la spro// de yang gter gzhung las/ bdag 'dra bai ro tsa na yis: khams gsum sems can thams cad kyi: gnyis 'dzin dri ma bsal ba'i phyir: bon chos gnyis kyi bcud bsdus nas: zab mo sku gsung thugs kyi sgrub pa bstan: zhes gsungs pa ltar/ phyogs zhen gyi dri ma bral zhing*/ bon chos kyi dgongs pa ro gcig tu rtogs nas/ dag snang dang mos gus lam du byed pa'i rnal 'byor pas/ rtsa gsum 'dus pa'i spyi dpal/ bla ma sgrub pa'i bcud 'dus/ bla chen yab sras gcig dril gyi sgrub thabs 'di nyid nyams su blang ba la'ang gsum ste/ gzhung las/ 'di la rnam pa gsum yin te: sbyor ba dngos gzhi mjug gsum mo: skal ldan bu yis nyams su longs: zhes gsungs pa ltar thog mar bla ma mtshan nyid dang ldan pa dbang gi chu rgyun ma chad pa las dbang mchog legs par thob nas/ gnas dben par mkho ba'i yo byad tshogs par bsags te/ dkyil 'khor sgo rdzogs kyi dbus su padma 'dab bzhi'i lte bar āom̐ āḥhūm̐ dang*/ ze'u 'brur g.yung drung gnyis dang rdo rje gnyis spel mar brgyan pa/ 'dab bzhir ha ri ni sa bzhi byang skor du bkod/ dbus su mañdzi'i khar bum pa rgyan ldan bcud kyis gtams pa dang*/ gzhan yang gtor ma sku gzugs kyis brgyan pa/ phyi nang mchod tshogs sogs rgya cher bshams la/ dam pa rang grol gyi snyan brgyud ltar tshan spos kyis bsang*/ de nas gta' chen phyi mtshams sa chog gi rim pa rgyas par spro tshe/ gsas mkhar rin po che spyi spungs ltar bya dgos kyang*/ 'dir de tsam gyi spros pa bskyung zhing tshogs dbang sogs dang 'brel par bya tshul 'grigs chags ni/ spyi 'gro ltar dkar gtor btang zhing snang srid zhi bde'i phrin las bcol/ rgyan rdzas 'god pa la dang po tshan chab 'thor zhing*/

āom̐: rin chen lnga las grub pa ste: gtsang zhing dag pa'i mchod rdzas la: bag chags dri ma mi mnga' yang: sems can nyon mongs dag pa'i phyir: tshan chab bdud rtsi lha yi chab: sman spos dri bzang dag pa'i chu: ye shes lha chab dag pa 'dis: mi gtsang dri ma dag gyur cig: āom̐ shuddho sa le sang nge ye swā hā: de nas spos kyis bdug ste/ āom̐: tsandan gla rtsi ga pur dang: rgya spos sbyar spos dri yi spos: dri ngad dud pa sprin du gtibs: rin chen mchod rdzas dag pa la: skyon dang 'bag rme mi mnga' yang: sems can bag chags dag bya'i phyir: spos dang dri yis skyon bsal lo: mi gtsang rme grib sangs gyur cig: āom̐ shim phod pra ti dhū pe a dkar ye swā hā: zhes dag gtsang bya zhing*/ bum snying bzlas shing bum rjas bsngags la blugs te bum pa 'god la/ tshig bshad ni/ āom̐: rin chen bum pa gzhal yas khang: ngo bo stong zhing bdag med dbyings: rnam pa so sor gsal ba mkha': dbyer med lha tshogs rang bzhin klong: rten dang brten par 'brel ba'i phyir: 'du 'bral med par bzhugs su gsol: a ma ha ra brtan du hrun: zhes dgod gtor ma bkod de/ e ma ho: mkha' dbyings rnam dag gtor gzhong du: 'dzad med longs spyod gtor mas bkang: ye shes lnga yi 'od zer 'phro: bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro'i tshogs:
